title: Firewall/Interfaces/Containers robustness hardening
acceptance_criteria: Firewall Zones supports local-zone configuration in parser, API payload, and UI forms.
Container networks are manageable through GUI-backed CRUD endpoints.
Dummy interfaces are manageable in a dedicated Network page using existing backend batch APIs.
Navigation exposes the dummy interface page and smoke routes include it.
Backend test coverage added for local-zone parser behavior.
Frontend typecheck/lint/build and runtime/browser smoke pass.
assumptions: Container network edits can be modeled as prefix-diff plus leaf set/delete operations.
Dummy interface management can remain on the existing batch endpoint without backend contract changes.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Implemented zone local-zone handling and container network CRUD endpoints; added parser tests for local-zone behavior.
Added zone local-zone controls, container network management card, and full dummy interfaces page with navigation.
Expanded smoke route coverage for new interfaces page and validated backend/frontend gates.
Manual review approved: additive, guide-aligned robustness improvements with preserved existing API contracts.
